articles.title: I Can't Predict the Future (and Neither Can You) (30 minute video)
articles.summary: After an injury forced her to slow down, Teresa Torres began experimenting with AI and gradually learned to build tools, agents, and production software. Small steps, curiosity, and a willingness to be a beginner can turn uncertainty into meaningful growth.

articles.title: Knowing When to Stop: The Art of Making a Loop Converge
articles.summary: Effective AI loops require more than repeated attempts. They need clear goals, editable work, reliable verification, and stopping rules that account for both progress and cost.

articles.title: Lessons From Three Product Leaders Living in the Future (60 minute video)
articles.summary: As AI makes building accessible to everyone, product leaders must spread customer judgment, remove unnecessary handoffs, and help small teams focus on the work that creates real value.

articles.title: The Framing Effect in UX: Identical Facts, Opposite Decisions
articles.summary: Every interface frames information, so designers should use transparent, balanced language that improves understanding instead of manipulating decisions.

articles.title: Before you delegate, ask yourself these 6 questions
articles.summary: Good delegation gives people the context, resources, expectations, and guardrails they need to succeed independently.

articles.title: The SaaS Extinction Test
articles.summary: Coding agents threaten simple workflow software, but systems of record and mission-critical platforms remain protected by data, operational complexity, and risk.

articles.title: When AI goes rogue
articles.summary: AI sandbox escapes highlight the limits of current safety controls and the urgent need for stronger safeguards, transparency, and regulation.

articles.title: Uber's tech chief says the AI ‘tokenmaxxing' era is ending
articles.summary: Rapidly increasing AI consumption is no longer a meaningful measure of success. Companies are moving toward disciplined spending, efficient models, and practical applications that produce measurable returns.

articles.title: Prompt injection isn't the bug, AI agent frameworks are
articles.summary: AI agent security risks extend beyond prompt injection because flaws in the surrounding frameworks can turn untrusted content into code execution, credential theft, and other serious attacks.

articles.title: Why Engineering Leaders Are Walking Away
articles.summary: Unrealistic AI expectations and weak company strategies are pushing engineering leaders toward fractional work, entrepreneurship, and career breaks.
